description_en: Runs a component in a playbook and returns the execution result of the component
description_zh: 执行剧本中的组件，并输出组件的运行结果
kebab_example: aliyun sophonsoar execute-component --playbook-uuid ac343acc-1a61-4084-9a1cxxxxx --play-book-node-name node1 --component-name SLS --component-action-name doRequest --component-asset-uuid 1C5F11E9-0000-51F0-0000-43BB312A0557 --component-input example-string --lang zh --api-version 2025-09-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteComponent

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the playbook.
You can call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
剧本的UUID。
调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

parameters.help_en: The node name of the current component in the playbook
parameters.help_zh: 当前组件在剧本中对应的节点名称
parameters.name: play_book_node_name

parameters.help_en: The action name of the component
parameters.name: component_action_name

parameters.help_en: The input parameters of the component
parameters.name: component_input

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RunResult.description_en: The execution result of the component
